case_title: BRADLEY, HEATHER VS WASHINGTON MUTUAL BANK

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $650.00 FILED BY BRADLEY, HEATHER AS TO DEFENDANT WASHINGTON MUTUAL BANK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-18-2000 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BRADLEY, HEATHER IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT WASHINGTON MUTUAL BANK PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST TO AMEND THE CLAIM TO $900. IS DENIED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
